name: Occupancy-Based Dual Contouring
definition: A dual contouring method designed for neural implicit functions defined in continuous 3D space, such as IM-NET, Occupancy Networks, or DeepSDF.
summary: Occupancy-Based Dual Contouring extracts meshes from neural implicit functions by avoiding distance reliance, using auxiliary 2D points for normals and Quadric Error Functions for vertex placement.
